overview: A one-page Department of State list of papers for decimal file 894.65, “Manufactures. Japan,” indexing industrial-intelligence material concerning Japanese manufacturing and munitions companies. The entries refer to a February 1942 Justice Department memorandum based on information from an outside source and to telegrams exchanged with Switzerland about companies designated under Japan’s January 17, 1944 munitions law and a list published in the March issue of the Tokyo Oriental Economist.

subfiles.title: List of papers concerning Japanese manufacturing and munitions companies
subfiles.about: An archival index identifies a memorandum and telegrams concerning Japanese industrial information and companies designated as munitions firms.
subfiles.summary: The sheet indexes a February 14, 1942 Justice Department memorandum containing Japanese industrial information received from an outside source. It also records telegram correspondence with Switzerland concerning a list of Japanese companies designated as munitions companies under the law of January 17, 1944. A July 3 telegram requests the list of firms printed in the March issue of the Tokyo Oriental Economist.

interest: This sheet is useful as a finding aid for reconstructing wartime American intelligence gathering on Japanese industrial mobilization. Its references connect information from an unidentified outside source with diplomatic efforts to obtain published lists of Japanese munitions firms through Switzerland. It also points to the Tokyo Oriental Economist as a source used to track implementation of Japan’s wartime munitions legislation.
